class.name: OcgAISRubberband
class.brief_description: Presentation for drawing rubber band selection. It supports rectangle and polygonal selection. It is constructed in 2d overlay. Default configuration is built without filling. For rectangle selection use SetRectangle() method. For polygonal selection use AddPoint() and GetPoints() methods.
class.description: ! Presentation for drawing rubber band selection. ! It supports rectangle and polygonal selection. ! It is constructed in 2d overlay. ! Default configuration is built without filling. ! For rectangle selection use SetRectangle() method. ! For polygonal selection use AddPoint() and GetPoints() methods.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs rubber band with default configuration: empty filling and white solid lines.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs the rubber band with empty filling and defined line style.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs the rubber band with defined filling and line parameters.

method.name: SetRectangle
method.description: Sets rectangle bounds.

method.name: RemoveLastPoint
method.description: Remove last point from the list of points for the rubber band polygon.

method.name: ClearPoints
method.description: Remove all points for the rubber band polygon.

method.name: LineColor
method.description: Returns the Color attributes.

method.name: SetLineColor
method.description: Sets color of lines for rubber band presentation.

method.name: FillColor
method.description: Returns the color of rubber band filling.

method.name: SetFillColor
method.description: Sets color of rubber band filling.

method.name: SetLineWidth
method.description: Sets width of line for rubber band presentation.

method.name: LineWidth
method.description: Returns width of lines.

method.name: SetLineType
method.description: Sets type of line for rubber band presentation.

method.name: LineType
method.description: Returns type of lines.

method.name: SetFillTransparency
method.description: Sets fill transparency.

method.name: FillTransparency
method.description: Returns fill transparency.

method.name: SetFilling_1
method.description: Enable or disable filling of rubber band.

method.name: SetFilling_2
method.description: Enable filling of rubber band with defined parameters.

method.name: IsFilling
method.description: Returns true if filling of rubber band is enabled.

method.name: IsPolygonClosed
method.description: Returns true if automatic closing of rubber band is enabled.

method.name: SetPolygonClosed
method.description: Automatically create an additional line connecting the first and the last screen points to close the boundary polyline
